newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE May commodities volume falls month/month.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE May commodities volume falls month/month.

text.p: Turnover for commodity products traded on the London International Financial Futures and Options Exchange (LIFFE) fell to 318,009 contracts in May from 414,714 in April, LIFFE said.

Cocoa and white sugar both showed sharp losses in futures turnover, although robusta coffee bucked the trend and saw 147,214 contracts traded in May after 124,180 the previous month, LIFFE said in a report.
Cocoa's futures volume in May more than halved to 88,428 contracts, down from 178,232 in April, while white sugar's volume fell to 42,517 contracts from 71,059.
Futures volume in wheat fell to 12,110 contracts from 16,606 in April.
White sugar and wheat both set monthly futures turnover records in April.
Overall futures volume reached 295,502 contracts in May after 399,547 in April.
In options, robusta coffee once again accounted for the bulk of the volume in May, which totalled 22,507 contracts compared with 15,167 in April.
